notes: Milestones multiply a generator's whole stack at owned thresholds. The peak_contract branch cuts active production immediately. Its peak applies once total owned copies reach peak_total_owned_at_least. The offer closes at commit_before_total_owned, still before that peak, so the purchase is only open while the immediate effect is a penalty. ROI integrates the change over roi_horizon_minutes. The peak sits close enough to the commit cap that the penalty is paid back inside that window only when total copies are already near the cap.
